# Frozen v0.5-style Control Room generated-code fixture.
# Purpose: preserve one deterministic outward executable surface while the
# v0.6 facade is developed in parallel.  This fixture is intentionally legacy
# code and should not be migrated until the outward-surface phase.
from cge_core import PyCGE, example_data
from cge_core.examples.stdcge_model_def import StdModelDef

cge = PyCGE(StdModelDef())
cge.model_data(example_data("stdcge"))
cge.model_instance("pf", "LAB")
cge.model_drop_redundant("eqpf", "LAB")
cge.model_calibrate()
cge.model_sim()
cge.model_modify_sim("taum", "BRD", 0)
cge.model_solve()
